mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.cert_type, c.cert_number, col.college_name, ce.event_name, ce.level, cs.session_name, sg.group_name, cc.category_name, c.cert_title, c.award_level, c.issue_date, c.resource_key, c.status, c.remark, c.reject_reason, -- 学生聚合（子查询避免笛卡尔积） (SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(u.real_name ORDER BY u.real_name), ARRAY[]::text[]) FROM certificate_recipient cr2 JOIN sys_user u ON cr2.user_id = u.id WHERE cr2.certificate_id = c.id) as student_names, (SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(u.student_id ORDER BY u.student_id), ARRAY[]::text[]) FROM certificate_recipient cr2 JOIN sys_user u ON cr2.user_id = u.id WHERE cr2.certificate_id = c.id) as student_ids, -- 教师聚合（从certificate_recipient.instructor_id获取，去重） (SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT u.real_name ORDER BY u.real_name), ARRAY[]::text[]) FROM certificate_recipient cr2 JOIN sys_user u ON cr2.instructor_id = u.id WHERE cr2.certificate_id = c.id) as teacher_names, (SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT u.teacher_id ORDER BY u.teacher_id), ARRAY[]::text[]) FROM certificate_recipient cr2 JOIN sys_user u ON cr2.instructor_id = u.id WHERE cr2.certificate_id = c.id) as teacher_ids FROM certificate c LEFT JOIN college col ON c.owner_college_id = col.id LEFT JOIN competition_event ce ON c.event_id = ce.id LEFT JOIN competition_session cs ON c.session_id = cs.id LEFT JOIN subject_group sg ON c.group_id = sg.id LEFT JOIN competition_category cc ON c.category_id = cc.id WHERE (c.cert_type = 'STUDENT' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM certificate_recipient cr WHERE cr.certificate_id = c.id AND cr.user_id = #{userId} )) OR (c.cert_type = 'INSTRUCTOR' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM certificate_instructor ci WHERE ci.certificate_id = c.id AND ci.user_id = #{userId} )) ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id

SELECT c.id, c.cert_type, c.cert_number, col.college_name, ce.event_name, ce.level, cs.session_name, sg.group_name, cc.category_name, c.cert_title, c.award_level, c.issue_date, c.resource_key, c.status, c.remark, c.reject_reason, -- 学生聚合 (SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(u.real_name ORDER BY u.real_name), ARRAY[]::text[]) FROM certificate_recipient cr2 JOIN sys_user u ON cr2.user_id = u.id WHERE cr2.certificate_id = c.id) as student_names, (SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(u.student_id ORDER BY u.student_id), ARRAY[]::text[]) FROM certificate_recipient cr2 JOIN sys_user u ON cr2.user_id = u.id WHERE cr2.certificate_id = c.id) as student_ids, -- 教师聚合（从certificate_recipient.instructor_id获取，去重） (SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT u.real_name ORDER BY u.real_name), ARRAY[]::text[]) FROM certificate_recipient cr2 JOIN sys_user u ON cr2.instructor_id = u.id WHERE cr2.certificate_id = c.id) as teacher_names, (SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT u.teacher_id ORDER BY u.teacher_id), ARRAY[]::text[]) FROM certificate_recipient cr2 JOIN sys_user u ON cr2.instructor_id = u.id WHERE cr2.certificate_id = c.id) as teacher_ids FROM certificate c INNER JOIN certificate_recipient cr ON cr.certificate_id = c.id LEFT JOIN college col ON c.owner_college_id = col.id LEFT JOIN competition_event ce ON c.event_id = ce.id LEFT JOIN competition_session cs ON c.session_id = cs.id LEFT JOIN subject_group sg ON c.group_id = sg.id LEFT JOIN competition_category cc ON c.category_id = cc.id WHERE cr.instructor_id = #{teacherUserId} AND c.cert_type = 'STUDENT' ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id

SELECT c.id, c.cert_type, c.cert_number, col.college_name, creator.username as creator_name, submitter.username as submitter_name, reviewer.username as reviewer_name, ce.event_name, ce.level, cs.session_name, sg.group_name, cc.category_name, c.cert_title, c.award_level, c.issue_date, c.resource_key, c.status, c.remark, c.reject_reason, c.reviewed_at, c.created_at, c.updated_at, -- 学生聚合（只有STUDENT类型有） CASE WHEN c.cert_type = 'STUDENT' THEN (SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(u.real_name ORDER BY u.real_name), ARRAY[]::text[]) FROM certificate_recipient cr2 JOIN sys_user u ON cr2.user_id = u.id WHERE cr2.certificate_id = c.id) ELSE ARRAY[]::text[] END as student_names, CASE WHEN c.cert_type = 'STUDENT' THEN (SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(u.student_id ORDER BY u.student_id), ARRAY[]::text[]) FROM certificate_recipient cr2 JOIN sys_user u ON cr2.user_id = u.id WHERE cr2.certificate_id = c.id) ELSE ARRAY[]::text[] END as student_ids, -- 教师聚合（STUDENT从instructor_id，INSTRUCTOR从certificate_instructor） CASE WHEN c.cert_type = 'STUDENT' THEN (SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT u.real_name ORDER BY u.real_name), ARRAY[]::text[]) FROM certificate_recipient cr2 JOIN sys_user u ON cr2.instructor_id = u.id WHERE cr2.certificate_id = c.id) ELSE (SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(u.real_name ORDER BY u.real_name), ARRAY[]::text[]) FROM certificate_instructor ci2 JOIN sys_user u ON ci2.user_id = u.id WHERE ci2.certificate_id = c.id) END as teacher_names, CASE WHEN c.cert_type = 'STUDENT' THEN (SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT u.teacher_id ORDER BY u.teacher_id), ARRAY[]::text[]) FROM certificate_recipient cr2 JOIN sys_user u ON cr2.instructor_id = u.id WHERE cr2.certificate_id = c.id) ELSE (SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(u.teacher_id ORDER BY u.teacher_id), ARRAY[]::text[]) FROM certificate_instructor ci2 JOIN sys_user u ON ci2.user_id = u.id WHERE ci2.certificate_id = c.id) END as teacher_ids FROM certificate c LEFT JOIN college col ON c.owner_college_id = col.id LEFT JOIN sys_user creator ON c.created_by = creator.id LEFT JOIN sys_user submitter ON c.submitter_user_id = submitter.id LEFT JOIN sys_user reviewer ON c.reviewer_user_id = reviewer.id LEFT JOIN competition_event ce ON c.event_id = ce.id LEFT JOIN competition_session cs ON c.session_id = cs.id LEFT JOIN subject_group sg ON c.group_id = sg.id LEFT JOIN competition_category cc ON c.category_id = cc.id WHERE c.id = #{certId}

-- ===== STUDENT 证书：按 certificate 聚合 ===== SELECT c.id, c.cert_type, c.cert_number, col.college_name, ce.event_name, ce.level, cs.session_name, sg.group_name, cc.category_name, c.cert_title, c.award_level, c.issue_date, c.resource_key, c.status, c.remark, c.reject_reason, c.created_at, -- 学生聚合 (SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(u.real_name ORDER BY u.real_name), ARRAY[]::text[]) FROM certificate_recipient cr2 JOIN sys_user u ON cr2.user_id = u.id WHERE cr2.certificate_id = c.id) as student_names, (SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(u.student_id ORDER BY u.student_id), ARRAY[]::text[]) FROM certificate_recipient cr2 JOIN sys_user u ON cr2.user_id = u.id WHERE cr2.certificate_id = c.id) as student_ids, -- 教师聚合（从certificate_recipient.instructor_id获取，去重） (SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT u.real_name ORDER BY u.real_name), ARRAY[]::text[]) FROM certificate_recipient cr2 JOIN sys_user u ON cr2.instructor_id = u.id WHERE cr2.certificate_id = c.id) as teacher_names, (SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT u.teacher_id ORDER BY u.teacher_id), ARRAY[]::text[]) FROM certificate_recipient cr2 JOIN sys_user u ON cr2.instructor_id = u.id WHERE cr2.certificate_id = c.id) as teacher_ids FROM certificate c LEFT JOIN college col ON c.owner_college_id = col.id LEFT JOIN competition_event ce ON c.event_id = ce.id LEFT JOIN competition_session cs ON c.session_id = cs.id LEFT JOIN subject_group sg ON c.group_id = sg.id LEFT JOIN competition_category cc ON c.category_id = cc.id WHERE c.owner_college_id = #{collegeId} AND c.cert_type = 'STUDENT'
UNION ALL
-- ===== INSTRUCTOR 证书：不聚合，每个教师单独一行 ===== SELECT c.id, c.cert_type, c.cert_number, col.college_name, ce.event_name, ce.level, cs.session_name, sg.group_name, cc.category_name, c.cert_title, c.award_level, c.issue_date, c.resource_key, c.status, c.remark, c.reject_reason, c.created_at, -- 学生：教师证书无获得者 ARRAY[]::text[] as student_names, ARRAY[]::text[] as student_ids, -- 教师：当前记录关联的教师本人（即证书持有者） ARRAY[holder.real_name]::text[] as teacher_names, ARRAY[holder.teacher_id]::text[] as teacher_ids FROM certificate_instructor ci INNER JOIN certificate c ON ci.certificate_id = c.id LEFT JOIN college col ON c.owner_college_id = col.id LEFT JOIN competition_event ce ON c.event_id = ce.id LEFT JOIN competition_session cs ON c.session_id = cs.id LEFT JOIN subject_group sg ON c.group_id = sg.id LEFT JOIN competition_category cc ON c.category_id = cc.id -- 关联获取当前证书持有教师的信息 LEFT JOIN sys_user holder ON ci.user_id = holder.id WHERE c.owner_college_id = #{collegeId} AND c.cert_type = 'INSTRUCTOR' ORDER BY created_at DESC, id

-- ===== STUDENT 证书：按 certificate 聚合 ===== SELECT c.id, c.cert_type, c.cert_number, col.college_name, ce.event_name, ce.level, cs.session_name, sg.group_name, cc.category_name, c.cert_title, c.award_level, c.issue_date, c.resource_key, c.status, c.remark, c.reject_reason, c.created_at, -- 学生聚合 (SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(u.real_name ORDER BY u.real_name), ARRAY[]::text[]) FROM certificate_recipient cr2 JOIN sys_user u ON cr2.user_id = u.id WHERE cr2.certificate_id = c.id) as student_names, (SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(u.student_id ORDER BY u.student_id), ARRAY[]::text[]) FROM certificate_recipient cr2 JOIN sys_user u ON cr2.user_id = u.id WHERE cr2.certificate_id = c.id) as student_ids, -- 教师聚合（从certificate_recipient.instructor_id获取，去重） (SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT u.real_name ORDER BY u.real_name), ARRAY[]::text[]) FROM certificate_recipient cr2 JOIN sys_user u ON cr2.instructor_id = u.id WHERE cr2.certificate_id = c.id) as teacher_names, (SELECT COALESCE(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT u.teacher_id ORDER BY u.teacher_id), ARRAY[]::text[]) FROM certificate_recipient cr2 JOIN sys_user u ON cr2.instructor_id = u.id WHERE cr2.certificate_id = c.id) as teacher_ids FROM certificate c LEFT JOIN college col ON c.owner_college_id = col.id LEFT JOIN competition_event ce ON c.event_id = ce.id LEFT JOIN competition_session cs ON c.session_id = cs.id LEFT JOIN subject_group sg ON c.group_id = sg.id LEFT JOIN competition_category cc ON c.category_id = cc.id WHERE c.cert_type = 'STUDENT'
UNION ALL
-- ===== INSTRUCTOR 证书：不聚合，每个教师单独一行 ===== SELECT c.id, c.cert_type, c.cert_number, col.college_name, ce.event_name, ce.level, cs.session_name, sg.group_name, cc.category_name, c.cert_title, c.award_level, c.issue_date, c.resource_key, c.status, c.remark, c.reject_reason, c.created_at, -- 学生：教师证书无获得者 ARRAY[]::text[] as student_names, ARRAY[]::text[] as student_ids, -- 教师：当前记录关联的教师本人 ARRAY[holder.real_name]::text[] as teacher_names, ARRAY[holder.teacher_id]::text[] as teacher_ids FROM certificate_instructor ci INNER JOIN certificate c ON ci.certificate_id = c.id LEFT JOIN college col ON c.owner_college_id = col.id LEFT JOIN competition_event ce ON c.event_id = ce.id LEFT JOIN competition_session cs ON c.session_id = cs.id LEFT JOIN subject_group sg ON c.group_id = sg.id LEFT JOIN competition_category cc ON c.category_id = cc.id LEFT JOIN sys_user holder ON ci.user_id = holder.id WHERE c.cert_type = 'INSTRUCTOR' ORDER BY created_at DESC, id
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM certificate WHERE cert_number = #{certNumber})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO certificate ( cert_type, cert_number, owner_college_id, created_by, submitter_user_id, reviewer_user_id, event_id, session_id, group_id, category_id, cert_title, award_level, issue_date, resource_key, status, remark, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{certType}, #{certNumber}, #{ownerCollegeId}, #{createdBy}, #{submitterUserId}, #{reviewerUserId}, #{eventId}, #{sessionId}, #{groupId}, #{categoryId}, #{certTitle}, #{awardLevel}, #{issueDate}, #{resourceKey}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE certificate SET event_id = #{eventId}, session_id = #{sessionId}, group_id = #{groupId}, category_id = #{categoryId}, cert_title = #{certTitle}, award_level = #{awardLevel}, issue_date = #{issueDate}, status = #{status}, reviewer_user_id = #{reviewerUserId}, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, remark = #{remark}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT col.college_name AS collegeName, ce.event_name AS eventName, ce.level AS level, ce.sponsor AS sponsor, c.award_level AS awardLevel, c.remark AS remark, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT stu.real_name, '、' ORDER BY stu.real_name) AS studentsStr, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT tch.real_name, '、' ORDER BY tch.real_name) AS instructorsStr FROM certificate c INNER JOIN college col ON c.owner_college_id = col.id INNER JOIN competition_event ce ON c.event_id = ce.id INNER JOIN certificate_recipient cr ON cr.certificate_id = c.id INNER JOIN sys_user stu ON cr.user_id = stu.id INNER JOIN sys_user tch ON cr.instructor_id = tch.id WHERE c.owner_college_id = #{collegeId} AND c.cert_type = 'STUDENT' AND c.status IN ('APPROVED', 'REISSUED') GROUP BY c.id, col.college_name, ce.event_name, ce.level, ce.sponsor, c.award_level, c.remark ORDER BY c.issue_date DESC, c.id

SELECT col.college_name AS collegeName, ce.event_name AS eventName, ce.level AS level, ce.sponsor AS sponsor, c.award_level AS awardLevel, c.remark AS remark, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT tch.real_name, '、' ORDER BY tch.real_name) AS instructorsStr FROM certificate c INNER JOIN college col ON c.owner_college_id = col.id INNER JOIN competition_event ce ON c.event_id = ce.id INNER JOIN certificate_instructor ci ON ci.certificate_id = c.id INNER JOIN sys_user tch ON ci.user_id = tch.id WHERE c.owner_college_id = #{collegeId} AND c.cert_type = 'INSTRUCTOR' AND c.status IN ('APPROVED', 'REISSUED') GROUP BY c.id, col.college_name, ce.event_name, ce.level, ce.sponsor, c.award_level, c.remark ORDER BY c.issue_date DESC, c.id

SELECT col.college_name AS collegeName, ce.event_name AS eventName, ce.level AS level, ce.sponsor AS sponsor, c.award_level AS awardLevel, c.remark AS remark, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT stu.real_name, '、' ORDER BY stu.real_name) AS studentsStr, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT tch.real_name, '、' ORDER BY tch.real_name) AS instructorsStr FROM certificate c INNER JOIN college col ON c.owner_college_id = col.id INNER JOIN competition_event ce ON c.event_id = ce.id INNER JOIN certificate_recipient cr ON cr.certificate_id = c.id INNER JOIN sys_user stu ON cr.user_id = stu.id INNER JOIN sys_user tch ON cr.instructor_id = tch.id WHERE cr.user_id = #{userId} AND c.cert_type = 'STUDENT' AND c.status IN ('APPROVED', 'REISSUED') GROUP BY c.id, col.college_name, ce.event_name, ce.level, ce.sponsor, c.award_level, c.remark ORDER BY c.issue_date DESC, c.id

SELECT col.college_name AS collegeName, ce.event_name AS eventName, ce.level AS level, ce.sponsor AS sponsor, c.award_level AS awardLevel, c.remark AS remark, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT tch.real_name, '、' ORDER BY tch.real_name) AS instructorsStr FROM certificate c INNER JOIN college col ON c.owner_college_id = col.id INNER JOIN competition_event ce ON c.event_id = ce.id INNER JOIN certificate_instructor ci ON ci.certificate_id = c.id INNER JOIN sys_user tch ON ci.user_id = tch.id WHERE ci.user_id = #{userId} AND c.cert_type = 'INSTRUCTOR' AND c.status IN ('APPROVED', 'REISSUED') GROUP BY c.id, col.college_name, ce.event_name, ce.level, ce.sponsor, c.award_level, c.remark ORDER BY c.issue_date DESC, c.id

SELECT col.college_name AS collegeName, ce.event_name AS eventName, ce.level AS level, ce.sponsor AS sponsor, c.award_level AS awardLevel, c.remark AS remark, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT stu.real_name, '、' ORDER BY stu.real_name) AS studentsStr, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT tch.real_name, '、' ORDER BY tch.real_name) AS instructorsStr FROM certificate c INNER JOIN college col ON c.owner_college_id = col.id INNER JOIN competition_event ce ON c.event_id = ce.id INNER JOIN certificate_recipient cr ON cr.certificate_id = c.id INNER JOIN sys_user stu ON cr.user_id = stu.id INNER JOIN sys_user tch ON cr.instructor_id = tch.id WHERE cr.instructor_id = #{teacherUserId} AND c.cert_type = 'STUDENT' AND c.status IN ('APPROVED', 'REISSUED') GROUP BY c.id, col.college_name, ce.event_name, ce.level, ce.sponsor, c.award_level, c.remark ORDER BY c.issue_date DESC, c.id

SELECT col.college_name AS collegeName, ce.event_name AS eventName, ce.level AS level, ce.sponsor AS sponsor, c.award_level AS awardLevel, c.remark AS remark, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT stu.real_name, '、' ORDER BY stu.real_name) AS studentsStr, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT tch.real_name, '、' ORDER BY tch.real_name) AS instructorsStr FROM certificate c INNER JOIN college col ON c.owner_college_id = col.id INNER JOIN competition_event ce ON c.event_id = ce.id INNER JOIN certificate_recipient cr ON cr.certificate_id = c.id INNER JOIN sys_user stu ON cr.user_id = stu.id INNER JOIN sys_user tch ON cr.instructor_id = tch.id WHERE c.cert_type = 'STUDENT' AND c.status IN ('APPROVED', 'REISSUED') GROUP BY c.id, col.college_name, ce.event_name, ce.level, ce.sponsor, c.award_level, c.remark ORDER BY c.issue_date DESC, c.id

SELECT col.college_name AS collegeName, ce.event_name AS eventName, ce.level AS level, ce.sponsor AS sponsor, c.award_level AS awardLevel, c.remark AS remark, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT tch.real_name, '、' ORDER BY tch.real_name) AS instructorsStr FROM certificate c INNER JOIN college col ON c.owner_college_id = col.id INNER JOIN competition_event ce ON c.event_id = ce.id INNER JOIN certificate_instructor ci ON ci.certificate_id = c.id INNER JOIN sys_user tch ON ci.user_id = tch.id WHERE c.cert_type = 'INSTRUCTOR' AND c.status IN ('APPROVED', 'REISSUED') GROUP BY c.id, col.college_name, ce.event_name, ce.level, ce.sponsor, c.award_level, c.remark ORDER BY c.issue_date DESC, c.id

SELECT c.resource_key FROM certificate c INNER JOIN certificate_recipient cr ON cr.certificate_id = c.id WHERE cr.user_id = #{userId} AND c.cert_type = 'STUDENT' AND c.status IN ('APPROVED', 'REISSUED') AND c.resource_key IS NOT NULL AND c.resource_key != ''

SELECT c.resource_key FROM certificate c INNER JOIN certificate_instructor ci ON ci.certificate_id = c.id WHERE ci.user_id = #{userId} AND c.cert_type = 'INSTRUCTOR' AND c.status IN ('APPROVED', 'REISSUED') AND c.resource_key IS NOT NULL AND c.resource_key != ''

SELECT c.resource_key FROM certificate c WHERE c.owner_college_id = #{collegeId} AND c.cert_type = 'STUDENT' AND c.status IN ('APPROVED', 'REISSUED') AND c.resource_key IS NOT NULL AND c.resource_key != ''

SELECT c.resource_key FROM certificate c WHERE c.owner_college_id = #{collegeId} AND c.cert_type = 'INSTRUCTOR' AND c.status IN ('APPROVED', 'REISSUED') AND c.resource_key IS NOT NULL AND c.resource_key != ''

SELECT c.resource_key AS resourceKey, c.owner_college_id AS collegeId, col.college_name AS collegeName FROM certificate c INNER JOIN college col ON c.owner_college_id = col.id WHERE c.cert_type = 'STUDENT' AND c.status IN ('APPROVED', 'REISSUED') AND c.resource_key IS NOT NULL AND c.resource_key != ''

SELECT c.resource_key AS resourceKey, c.owner_college_id AS collegeId, col.college_name AS collegeName FROM certificate c INNER JOIN college col ON c.owner_college_id = col.id WHERE c.cert_type = 'INSTRUCTOR' AND c.status IN ('APPROVED', 'REISSUED') AND c.resource_key IS NOT NULL AND c.resource_key != ''

SELECT c.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM certificate c INNER JOIN certificate_instructor ci ON c.id = ci.certificate_id WHERE ci.user_id = #{teacherUserId} AND c.cert_type = 'INSTRUCTOR' GROUP BY c.status
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cr.user_id) FROM certificate_recipient cr INNER JOIN certificate c ON cr.certificate_id = c.id WHERE cr.instructor_id = #{teacherUserId} AND c.status IN ('APPROVED', 'REISSUED')

SELECT c.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM certificate c INNER JOIN certificate_recipient cr ON c.id = cr.certificate_id WHERE cr.user_id = #{studentUserId} AND c.cert_type = 'STUDENT' GROUP BY c.status
SELECT c.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM certificate c WHERE c.cert_type = #{certType} GROUP BY c.status
